answer: Every ballot in the meadow stakes a plot and names its price — an ivory deed, public — then pays 7% of it in tax every epoch, and anyone may buy the ballot at its named price. A farm minting 10,000 fakes at $1 each to dodge the tax dies by the buyout: one challenger pays $10,000, takes the field, every fake seized and burned. Priced honestly at $25, they cost $17,500 tax per epoch, $280,000 across 16 epochs, plus a $25 bond each, and a missed payment freezes a ballot in 24 hours. Like nectar set by the flower: cheap and a gardener picks it for $10,000, dear and the rent eats $280,000.
